Whether you're just starting with kitesurfing or are already an experienced kiter, you'll find everything you need for your perfect kite day with us. We offer professional kite lessons for all levels based on recognized VDWS standards. Our experienced instructors ensure you make quick progress safely and with fun.</p>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <p class="mb-3 psjustify">For the perfect kite day, we offer not only state-of-the-art kite equipment rental with the newest Core kites, but also a comfortable beach boy service on the shore, so you can focus completely on the wind and water.</p>

<div class="bg-white">

		    <div class="row d-flex align-items-center">
      <div class="col-md-6 text-center">
        <a href="https://www.vdws.de/" target="_blank">
          <img src="images/kiteschool/vdws.png" class="img-fluid w-75" />
        </a>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h1 class="text-left mb-3">VDWS kite school.</h1>
        <p class="psjustify" >Our kite school in Ilha do Guajiru is VDWS-certified and offers everything you'd expect from a modern kite station. You'll have access to trained instructors who will passionately and joyfully help you get started with your new sport, regain confidence after a long break, or boost you to the next level with intensive courses. Additionally, you'll benefit from other VDWS advantages like the VDWS Safety Tool and premium insurance when renting kite equipment, so you can kite worry-free even if something goes wrong.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

				<div class="row d-flex align-items-center mt-5">

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h1 class="text-left mb-3">VDWS License.</h1>
        <p class="psjustify" >At our VDWS-licensed school, we also conduct VDWS kite license certifications. The card helps you when renting equipment or documenting your VDWS kite training to local authorities. Requirements include participating in one of our kite courses and passing a theoretical test. The training is based on materials provided by VDWS. The VDWS skill-level system consists of 7 levels plus a theory step. For the 'classic' basic certification, Level 5 and the theory level are required. You can also upgrade your existing VDWS license level.</p>
      </div>

			<div class="col-md-6 text-center">
        <img src="images/kiteschool/lizenz.png" class="img-fluid w-75" />
      </div>

      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6">
        <h1 class="text-left mb-3">Core Material.</h1>
        <p class="psjustify">In our kite school, you can test or rent the latest Core equipment - right on site! We've been working with Core Kites for years and offer a wide selection of kites like the XR and NEXUS - perfect for every riding style. We update our inventory every season so you're always on the water with the newest gear. In addition to Core kites, we outfit you with premium equipment from ION, Nobile and Future. This way, you're always perfectly equipped to get the most out of your kite adventure!</p>

Here you're guaranteed to succeed - even if you haven't managed it elsewhere!</p>
			<p class="psjustify">You've already mastered your first meters and now want to really go big or finally learn that specific trick?</p>
